file: 369 In This Roblox Game Your Fry Shop Turns Into a Horror Game.mp4

lines.t: This new fun game on Roblox starts as a fry shop. Then 8 PM hits.

full.credit: Clips: AnyaRoblox; Peggy Network (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

sc.big:
THIS NEW FUN
GAME ON ROBLOX

lines.t: In the day, you peel potatoes, make fries and sell them to customers.

full.credit: Clips: AnyaRoblox; Peggy Network (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: But at night, the lights flicker and anomalies show up. Something at the window. A potato eater. And a giant outside.

full.credit: Clips: AnyaRoblox; Peggy Network (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: It came out in September and already has over 95 million visits.

full.credit: Clips: AnyaRoblox; Peggy Network (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Would you survive the night shift?

full.credit: Clips: AnyaRoblox; Peggy Network (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
